picks.title: “I Spent 15 Years Making Movies the Old Way. Now I’m, Reluctantly, an AI Guy”
picks.headline: “I Spent 15 Years Making Movies the Old Way. Now I’m, Reluctantly, an AI Guy”
picks.excerpt: A producer with 15 years of traditional moviemaking experience walks through his shift to generative-AI tools in pre- and post-production, arguing that folding AI into the workflow can lower costs and democratize filmmaking rather than replace human creativity — a first-person view of how AI is reshaping a working film craftsperson's pipeline.
picks.rationale: High actionability: a working producer's concrete, first-person account of how generative AI folds into a real pre/post pipeline — changes how a filmmaker approaches tomorrow's workflow.
